notes.title: OUT NOW: Creaks - Bonus, Live & Remixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/65a9f49a16fb4c42f94b7584750fa982de5b1a77.png[/img]

The new album "Creaks: Bonus, Live & Remixes" is now available for streaming and download! If you're an owner of the Creaks Soundtrack DLC here on Steam, please check out its download folder - an mp3 version of the album is waiting there for you ːcreakskissː Still we'd like to encourage you to support Hidden Orchestra directly if you enjoy their music - [url=https://hiddenorchestra.bandcamp.com/album/creaks-bonus-live-remixes]Bandcamp[/url] is a good place for that! And you'll also find it on all your favorite spotifies etc.

The record brings seven previously-unreleased tracks from the original soundtrack, plus two extensively reimagined live band versions, and seven remixes from a very diverse set of artists including Floex and Ben Lukas Boysen, all interspersed to create an adventurous yet cohesive new album. 

Once you're done listening, don't forget to let us know about your favorite tracks in the comments! 

Tracklist:
1. Welcome to Towers - Hidden Orchestra Remix 
2. Bridges - Live 
3. Fish Painting 
4. Palace End - Floex Remix (extended album version)
5. Guitarist Painting 
6. Tangle - Poppy Ackroyd Rework
7. Three Islands - Live
8. Towers End Below
9. Trunk - Tommy Perman Remix 
10. Stealth Painting 
11. Extending - Ben Lukas Boysen Rework
12. Beginning 
13. Armoured - ZKA4T Remix
14. Cello and Clarinet Theme (AI-generated arrangement) 
15. Guitarist Painting - chiefko Remix
16. Towers End Above

notes.title: NEW MUSIC: Listen to two tracks from Creaks: Bonus, Live & Remixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/65a9f49a16fb4c42f94b7584750fa982de5b1a77.png[/img]

We're happy to share with you the first single from the upcoming album [b]Creaks: Bonus, Live & Remixes[/b], set to release for download and streaming this [b]November 11[/b]. Listen to the first two tracks - an energetic live version of 'Three Islands' and an epic remix of 'Palace End' by Floex (aka Tomáš Dvořák) below, or on your platform of choice via [url=lnk.to/threeislands]this link[/url]. If you'd like to support the new release, please make sure you check out [url=https://hiddenorchestra.bandcamp.com/album/creaks-bonus-live-remixes]Hidden Orchestra's Bandcamp[/url].

[previewyoutube=Wfl-XPJUMho;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube=AWgQASHQOGU;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h1][/h1]

Here's what Joe Acheson (aka Hidden Orchestra) had to say about the new record:

"[i]I'm very excited to share this unusual and interesting collection of tracks, revisiting and expanding upon the Creaks album, with seven new tracks developed from the soundtrack, two live versions recorded earlier this year in Luxembourg, and seven remixes from a diverse selection of artists who all have some tangential connection with the original album - including Floex, Poppy Ackroyd, Ben Lukas Boysen and Tommy Perman.

The wildly reimagined bass clarinet and drum-fuelled version of Three Islands and Floex's intense synth-laden reinterpretation of Palace End nicely represent some of the range of the full record..
I hope you find something to enjoy.[/i]"

notes.title: Creaks Finally Gets Its Steam Trading Cards Set!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/4f2b1d1e374783a4aad7d835289552b717b7a53d.jpg[/img]

It took us [i]a while[/i], but the Steam Trading Cards set that some of you have been waiting for is finally live! You know how it works - collect the entire set of 5 cards by playing the game and trading with other players, craft a badge and get rewards. If you're in it just for the rewards, you'll also find all emoji and profile backgrounds from this set in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/]Points Shop[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/5bef2d43683cb45cdd1e5ebbc75a7a1bfb4cbd83.jpg[/img]

What's special about this set is that the cards feature a brand new series of pictures highlighting the characters' unique personalities and giving you a closer look at their designs. We hope they were worth the wait and that they'll motivate you to some trading:) Have you got a favorite?

[h2]What's there to collect:[/h2]
[list]
[*]5 trading cards
[*]5 regular badges + 1 foil badge
[*]3 profile backgrounds
[*]6 creaky emoji ːcreaksheroː ːcreakskissː ːcreaksangrydogː ːcreaksgoatː ːcreakslibrarianː ːcreakssurprisedː
[/list]
Enjoy the rest of your summer, and have fun collecting!

notes.title: Celebrate the 1st Creak-iversary!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/GIS8X8b8uLgFmKpyEI/giphy.gif[/img]

We are celebrating Creaks' 1st anniversary and we have got plenty of delicious cake for everyone!

Creaks came out on Steam last year on July 22, and since then we've been endlessly grateful for your support. As a little token of gratitude, we baked (animated? ani-baked?) you a cake, and prepared a bunch of discounts for those of you who would like to have a piece of Creaks at home. Also, we're curious - can you dedicated fans tell what inspired the way the cake looks?

Whether you want to grab the [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/creaks-soundtrack-2lp-by-hidden-orchestra]vinyl soundtrack[/url] by Hidden Orchestra, a [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/creaks-t-shirt]stylish t-shirt[/url], or the recently released art book [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/the-art-of-creaks]'The Art of Creaks'[/url], you can now get these with 15% off in [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks]our store[/url]. All you need to do is enter the code below at checkout. The code will remain active until August 10.

[h2]1CREAKIVERSARY[/h2]


By the way - [b]our fan art contest's submission period ends this Thursday[/b], so please don't forget to submit your work in time! You will find more information in this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/956030/view/2969543143061192217]Steam post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/fbfd5ddd9e096cff3e5b5b3bc7cb90a9ca5f302b.png[/img]

Thank you, and happy creaking!

notes.title: First Look at 'The Art of Creaks' Deluxe Art Book, and more
notes.content:
Did anybody ask for an art book? Vinyl? T-shirts? Collector's edition?

Well, if you did ask about either of those things, here's some good news - we've got something for you! For the past few months, we've been working on a bunch of physical items to accompany Creaks, and it's about time to introduce them to you. Let's start with the latest stuff!

[h2]The Art of Creaks[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/59f863d1f55be486489e6dc7290ce2e681e047dc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/767026459df40a6f1dd4e9bb9014058faaa1af20.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/48fd481241ee607abf370fa3bf75073ebfb3266a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/3b28aef344af5ce0edca4773400c22b7c4dfea5b.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/5516721d14a619066e6c9ebcf6c2ec092db77413.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/f7b731781ad1f089bd19e5e76cbc2d9a39f6d378.jpg[/img][/url]

Fresh out of the printer, this is '[b]The Art of Creaks[/b]', a new deluxe art book featuring concept art, sketches, design concepts, final visuals as well as insight from the creators on 180 pages of quality paper. The format is 27x27 cm square, and the English version is available for pre-order via our [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/the-art-of-creaks]merch store[/url]. This one starts shipping next week!

[h2]Creaks Collector's Box[/h2] (Limited to 1000 units)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/8f7137cac13c08c14caa6c1306da0ad3ffb621df.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/c3a7e5101d14312ef71dc81e628ad380c3c21e22.jpg[/img][/url]

Another thing that starts shipping next week is the limited [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/creaks-collectors-edition][b]Creaks Collector's Box[/b][/url]. This big box includes the above-mentioned art book, two exclusive metal pins, the soundtrack by Hidden Orchestra on CD, four lithographs, a high-quality double-sided poster, a Steam key, and a certificate of authenticity, signed and hand-numbered by the creators. Also available in our merch store with new photos coming in the next few days.

[h2]Creaks Soundtrack 2LP[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/f8f9f8291ffbb681161021ee5722102de3325bc4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/c74d02784feeda757c545f141e37dff0c29eb48f.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/62bf033dffc00a0337f41f05ea2e0d6764b9e9e2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/914e3918386cd17ae7b009ab7fb9d354413c2005.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/1293cd0c16adcbf08146ec8c5de5c539a60e5d0d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/fe9ac6fbae2b0e49ce1c56775f68d29239a62996.jpg[/img][/url]

If you, like us, can't get enough of Hidden Orchestra's music for Creaks, take a look at this [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/creaks-soundtrack-2lp-by-hidden-orchestra]precious light-blue 2LP[/url] (180 grams) featuring 15 diverse tracks on two discs. Accompanied by 6 art prints by the game's creators Radim Jurda and Jan Chlup and FLAC download code, packed in a velvet finish gatefold cover.

[h2]Creaks T-Shirt[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/6ebca424f3081f7941466c0c0b557320a5293d02.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/828b5ef845f3f3731f6d0a3624d6ceb066cdbb08.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/ebac7ecd4b9e42a664378d9bcbd7e105b691742f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/aa1d6e2288fae1a734e96239e36ac0dee8c4ff4f.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/fd03900ba9b80148ded1f38bad7eb9fce8275d54.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/7aaf9382c7e890769533099a7316ddfa3067404e.jpg[/img][/url]

About a year and a half ago, one of our artists Eva Marková designed the T-shirt for Machinarium's 10th anniversary. Eva was kind enough to help us design yet another shirt, using some of the game's most prominent features and characters and picturing them in a distinct minimalistic style - just the right thing for a fashionable T-shirt! Available in [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/creaks-t-shirt]unisex[/url], [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/creaks-ladies-t-shirt]ladies[/url] and [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/creaks-kids-t-shirt]kids[/url] sizes.

We're very grateful for the support you've shown us over the years, buying our games as well as soundtracks on vinyl, t-shirts, or plushies. We hope you'll like these new products just as much if you decide to grab some! ːmuchomurkaː

notes.title: New Creaks update adds save slot selection
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/349fd2694dcbe5fa77449317f9698ccb6d9d3c17.png[/img]

A new Creaks update (Windows & Mac) just landed on Steam! 

Aside from the usual bug fixes, there's [b]a new feature[/b] for those who'd like to use multiple save slots on just one Steam profile. With this update, you can [b]choose from three separate save slots[/b] at the new selection screen. These saves are shared across Windows and Mac platforms if you have Steam Cloud enabled.

You'll be able to access the slot selection screen either at startup or from the main menu.

Enjoy! ːmuchomurkaː
